title: Guest Wi-Fi Incident Response
description: Guest Wi-Fi failures affecting hotel guest experience
triggers: Complete guest Wi-Fi outage at hotel properties
Wi-Fi performance degradation affecting guest experience
immediate_actions: Identify scope of Wi-Fi failure (single property vs multi-property)
Notify hotel management of connectivity status
Implement wired connections for guest areas if available
investigation_steps: Check wireless access point status and logs
Verify network connectivity to access points
Analyze wireless signal patterns and interference
resolution_steps: Restart failed access points following standard procedures
Implement network controller fixes if needed
Apply wireless configuration changes or optimizations
Coordinate with wireless vendor for complex issues
verification: Test Wi-Fi connectivity at affected properties
Verify guest device connectivity and performance
Check wireless coverage in guest areas
Confirm with hotel staff that Wi-Fi is operational
special_considerations: Guest-facing outages take precedence over back-office issues
Guest Wi-Fi is important for guest satisfaction
Communicate with guests about connectivity status
